GABAPENTIN FOR GBL WITHDRAWAL
About 3 months ago I started heavily using GBL. Almost instantly I was using on a 24/7 basis (have previously been addicted to BDO) starting at 1.5ml every 3 hours and then getting rapidly worse and eventually was taking 4ml every 2 hours. And to make it worse I was no longer feeling the effects like I was initially, its almost like I was taking it just to be normal now and if I took too much would just get tired and fall asleep instead of any enjoyable euphoria.
Oh and if I lost my doses while I was out and about I would go almost instantly into withdrawals and the longer it went the scarier it got to the point where I was having auditory hallucinations and hearing people screaming the scariest and most horrific screams you could imagine. But as soon as I would even have 1ml they would somewhat subside and go away so yeah best to say I was so scared about coming off GBL.
I was so scared about coming off GBL.
Keeping all this in mind I could feel the sun was going to be setting on my multiple month long GBL Binge (due to personal reasons and just being withdrawn from my family due to the nature of my addiction). So I did my research on how to get off it. I acquired the following items:
Gabapentin 300MG (50 capsules)
Seroquel 25MG (60 tablets)
Valium 5mg (25 tablets)
Baclofen 10mg (100 tablets)
So now that I acquired all these important items I bought my last 100ml vowing to not touch it unless I go to the gym.
I took my last big dose of 4.5ml  and had an amazing sleep. Woke up took 1.5ml to subside any withdrawal effects while the tablets kicked in. I then consumed the following:
Gabapentin 2100mg ( 7 capsules)
Baclofen 80mg (8 tablets)
Seroquel 25 mg (1 tablet)
T(0.00h) consumed medicinals cocktail and 1.5ml of GBL to subside any withdrawals I had while Gabapentin kicks in
(0.50) GBL has taken away any withdrawals and I feel okay just a little nervous that will be my last dose
(1.50) Gabapentin kicking in slight ensuing in head but I figure thats okay
(3.00) Gabapentin in full force and its kicking in hard feeling actually really good and sorta like Im on a good dose of G
(3.50) fall asleep
I slept from 11pm till 3 AM however upon awaking at 3 AM I had intense shakes and was close to convulsing so I had a small 1ml dose of GBL went back to sleep woke up at 6am, took 900mg of gabapentin and have not touched GBL since.
I did take 70mg of baclofen for 3 days and then cut that out completely and havent had GBL since.
Well apart from on gym days of course.
